descriptions.description: Conopodium is a genus of flowering plants belonging to the family Apiaceae. Its native range is north-western Europe and the Mediterranean.

The following species are recognised in the genus Conopodium: Conopodium arvense Conopodium bunioides Conopodium glaberrimum Conopodium majus Conopodium marianum Conopodium pyrenaeum Conopodium subcarneum Conopodium thalictrifolium
